cues.text: In Paulownia Mall's fountain square, a small boy runs up near you and Yukari and stops, on his own.
Yukari walks over to the boy, and he turns and wanders a few steps away.
The boy and his mother walk off across the square together. Yukari watches them go.
Later, you and Yukari sit side by side on a bench.
Yukari holds out her phone strap, a little charm hanging from it, and places it in your hand.
